finalText:
Found 11 straggler files still on `db.query` and moved them all to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

They were `sla.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `returnService.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js`, and `apiKeyAdmin.js`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and `cache.query` calls untouched, since those aren't part of the migration. The verify script now passes clean.
